name: Productos — crear producto y editar su nombre
description: Como admin, el usuario crea un producto nuevo en el catálogo y después edita su nombre; el listado refleja el nombre actualizado.

planSteps.description: Sign in with the admin email and password configured for this project
Open the Productos section from the sidebar navigation
Open the Agregar productos action to create a new product
Fill the create product form with a unique SKU starting with TS-CREATE, a distinctive product name containing TS Create, a brand if required, and a valid price
Locate the newly created product in the catalog table by its SKU or name
Open the Ver / Editar action for that product
Change the product name to a new distinctive value containing TS Edited
Verify the catalog list or product detail shows the edited name containing TS Edited for that product, not the original create name
